rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway condition, which is a clear liability scenario covered under the homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on an icy walkway in front of the policyholder's house during an ice storm last week. Parents are seeking coverage for medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury claim on the policyholder's premises.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway during ice storm
